verdict.rationale: Bruno runs entirely on the user's own machines. It is offline-only with no cloud sync, account, or login, and stores collections as plain-text files on the local filesystem. It ships desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus official Docker images for the CLI that run in CI or locally. Its AI features use bring-your-own-key and can point at self-hosted or local models such as Ollama, with no data routed through Bruno servers. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license or build-from-source documentation in the evidence, clarity on whether paid Ultimate features need vendor licensing infrastructure, and independent corroboration of fully self-contained operation.
